predecessor_finding_dispositions.evidence: validate_envelope now uses the same 768-byte chunk rule as executor deployment: ceil(98,016/768)+2 = 130, which is covered by the maximum 192 deployment submissions. The focused test passes.

Build-time signature enforcement was removed. Binding 007, the guide and deferred-choice record now state that the runner does not authenticate human authorization, that the authenticated operator workflow is the external trust boundary, and that cryptographic provenance is deferred. This does not prove that external workflow; it removes the false runtime claim.
Public state binds key and envelope commitments, but only the exact executor's B2 opening demonstrates decryptability; the program itself does not verify HPKE.
Recipient observations continue to emit the deterministic plaintext commitment in terminal evidence.

The fsync JSONL attempt journal remains unauthenticated, not hash-linked and not packet/trial-bound; reconciliation checks signature finality without reconstructing program, artifact or storage state.

The key directory remains overwriteable and initial prepare/open paths do not universally derive every binding/fingerprint. The exact executor still constructs coherent bindings and pre-opens A, B and B2.
calculated_test_sol_lamports is still supplied by the technical envelope and individual protocol-PDA rents are not precomputed or separately itemized.

Prepare creates a mode-0700 external directory and sets secret files to 0600, with HPKE private bytes explicitly zeroized after writes. Memory locking, encrypted-at-rest custody, broader same-user process isolation and explicit Solana Keypair zeroization remain external trusted-host responsibilities.
The lockfile is exact, but no current advisory/license/provenance assessment, deny policy or SBOM is joined.

The exact deployment-budget contradiction has a regression test, but prepare has no direct test and loader, journal, ambiguous RPC/finality, reconciliation and 15-case closure still lack deterministic mock/fault-injection coverage.
The seven abstract formal claims remain PASS_BOUNDED and do not prove Rust, SQL, Solana, operator authorization or external effects.

unresolved_findings.title: Runtime-generated receipts still represent effects as authority
unresolved_findings.evidence: PreparationReceipt sets authority_effect to local-credential-creation-only-no-rpc-no-airdrop-no-deployment; ReconciliationReceipt sets authority_effect to status-reconciliation-and-journal-append-no-resubmission; TrialEvidence sets authority_effect to bounded-public-devnet-effects-executed. The attempt journal records authorized-execution-start and TrialEvidence claims Exact authorized public Devnet v1 trial. The same runner now correctly states that it cannot authenticate human authorization.
unresolved_findings.impact: A runtime-generated artifact can be misread or machine-consumed as proof of authorization even though the external operator workflow is the only authority source. This recreates authority inflation at the evidence-field layer after cryptographic enforcement was correctly deferred.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Set authority_effect to none in every runtime-generated receipt. Introduce separate local_effect, external_effect or observed_effect fields for credential creation, reconciliation and Devnet execution. Rename authorized-execution-start to operator-invoked-execution-start and change the runtime claim ceiling to say authorization is external and not attested by the runner. Add regression tests that no runtime output claims authority.

unresolved_findings.title: Effectful runner failures can be masked by tee pipeline exit status
unresolved_findings.evidence: The guide invokes prepare, execute and reconcile through pipelines ending in tee but does not establish pipefail or separately inspect PIPESTATUS. A nonzero runner may therefore yield a zero pipeline status from tee.
unresolved_findings.impact: A scripted operator can miss the required stop-at-first-effectful-failure boundary even though the prose instructs stopping.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Use a shell with set -o pipefail, capture and check the runner status explicitly, or avoid tee for effectful invocations.
